description.value: The study examined stigma resistance and emotion regulation in patients with schizophrenia and healthy control subjects using implicit association measurements and fMRI activation during schizophrenia-related and control statement evaluation.

spans.text: Our findings suggest that individual stigma resistance is associated with emotion regulation.
